units.source_text: 堀木只是出於好玩的心理，他把我介紹給這個聚會後就再也沒參加過，

en.t: Horiki had only done it for fun, and after introducing me to that gathering, he never attended again.

units.source_text: 他曾給我開過一句玩笑：「馬克思主義者在研究生產的同時，也有必要考察消費嘛。」

en.t: He once made a joke to me: "While Marxists study production, they also need to examine consumption."

units.source_text: 所以他不去參加聚會，只是一味地想叫我去考察消費。

en.t: So he did not go to the meetings himself, but simply kept trying to send me off to examine consumption.

units.source_text: 回想起來，當時各種型別的馬克思主義者還真有不少。

en.t: Thinking back on it, there really were many different kinds of Marxists at the time.

units.source_text: 有像堀木這樣出於虛榮的趕時髦而以此自居者；

en.t: There were people like Horiki, who called themselves Marxists out of vanity and a desire to follow the fashion.

units.source_text: 又不乏像我一樣，只是喜歡那種「非法」的氛圍而坐在聚會中的人。

en.t: And there were more than a few people like me, who sat in those meetings simply because they liked the atmosphere of something "illegal."
